scripts.build:native: node scripts/prepare-pdf-assets.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode native
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:native && cap sync android
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:native && cap sync ios
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts vite.config.ts capacitor.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts vite.config.ts capacitor.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json index.html
